summary: Round 5: tested the IIDE-style hero on /free-counselling (backend plus UI at 1920/1440/1280/1024/390) and the home hero regression. The hero renders as specified. The grid background, navy H1, bold 'Talk on Call or Visit Our Pathankot Campus.' line, counselling-logo-strip (36 imgs, 0 broken), 3-item highlights, tel: call link, form card on a blue shape and 3 badges all show. With the float animation paused, no badge's bounding box overlaps the name/phone/education/track inputs or the submit button at any desktop width. Below sm the badges are hidden. The form works as before: an empty submit triggers native required validation, an invalid phone shows the toast 'Please enter a valid 10-digit phone number', a valid submit returns POST /api/counselling-leads 200 and redirects to /thank-you?source=counselling&name=..., and the lead is stored in Mongo. On mobile 390 there is no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390), the counselling-mobile-book-btn scrolls to #top, and the input accepts typing. The rest of the page renders: credentials, how it works, coverage, partners, testimonials, FAQ, final CTA and footer, with no broken images. Home hero regression: hero-logo-strip has 36 loaded imgs and all 3 hero badges are visible.

minor.issue: This test is out of date and unrelated to Round 5. It checks backend.err.log for 'CRM webhook sent: <name>', but the endpoint now calls queue_crm_lead (async queue), so the log line is not found. The API itself returns 200. The test also creates leads without cleaning them up. I deleted the one it created by id.

issues: counselling-badge-rating (right edge at x=1288) and counselling-badge-callback (right edge at x=1296) get cut off by the viewport/section overflow-hidden, so their text is clipped ('Callback in' shows as 'Callback i'). The xl:-right-10/-right-12 offsets apply from 1280, where container padding is only 32px. Consider using xl:-right-4 or applying the larger offsets only at 2xl.

counselling-badge-callback sits over the '5000+ trained' trust item in the card footer. It does not cover any input. The selects are also narrow, so the placeholders are truncated ('Education *' cut off, 'Preferred T...').

The #top anchor is on the <form>, so after the jump the name input sits flush at viewport top 0 and the card heading 'Book Your Free Session' is scrolled out of view. Consider adding scroll-mt-6 or moving id=top to counselling-form-card.

counselling-header has 'sticky top-0' but does not stick, because html and body have overflow-x:hidden (after scrolling, the header rect is at -1500). This is probably pre-existing and site-wide. Using overflow-x:clip on html/body would make sticky work.
